name: Minimal Rust OS that boots into Doom

mentions.name: Minimal Rust OS that boots into Doom
mentions.description: This project builds the simplest possible operating system in Rust that boots directly into a game of Doom, with Doom itself being rewritten in Rust. It is a long-term (18-month) learning project aimed at deeply understanding operating systems, video game development, and Rust.
mentions.problem: Deeply understanding operating systems, video game development, and Rust through hands-on building.
mentions.source_excerpt: building the simplest possible OS in Rust that boots directly into a game of Doom, which will also be re-written in Rust
